_comment: Gold labels for the Tender Compiler benchmark. Each case lists planted issues as [rule_id, clause_key]; 'no_critical' cases must produce zero critical findings (false-alarm check).

cases.text: 2.1 Cement: OPC 53 grade conforming to IS 12269:2013 shall be supplied with ISI mark.
3.1 Cables: 1100 V grade PVC insulated copper cables of Polycab make only, with ISI mark.
5.1 Water: Drinking water conforming to IS 10500:2012 with TDS not more than 2500 mg/l and pH between 6.5 and 8.5.
2.1 Luminaire: LED luminaire 120 W conforming to IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 1):2012, IP66, power factor not less than 1.2, with CRS registration.

3.1 Cement: OPC 43 grade conforming to IS 269:2015 with ISI mark.
3.2 Testing: Each lot shall be tested for 28 days compressive strength before dispatch.
6.1 Delivery: Supply shall be delivered within 7 days from the date of Purchase Order.

4.1 Bars: TMT bars Grade Fe 500D conforming to IS 1786:2008 with ISI mark.
4.2 Yield: Yield stress shall not be less than 500 N/mm2.
4.3 Cap: Yield stress shall not be more than 450 N/mm2.
4.4 Ductility: Elongation shall not be less than 14%.
4.1 Bars: TMT bars conforming to IS 1786:2008 Fe 500D or BS 4449:2005 B500B.
2.1 Pipes: HDPE pipes of good quality as per relevant IS codes.
